title: lint result
description: Offline contract check: bundled task schema, then the reviewed-contract rules. No GitHub or Git reads; never readiness or authorization.

schema_version.description: The contract's schema_version when it is a string, else null

review_errors.description: Reviewed-contract blockers; empty when the schema is invalid

reviewed.description: Schema valid with no review errors; sets the exit status

contract_sha256.description: Canonical contract hash; null when the schema is invalid
